description.en: The ID of the database. Call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to obtain this ID.

title.zh: 获取表的字段知识列表

descriptions.zh: 查询表的字段知识列表，返回每个字段的元信息（类型、可空、自增等）、业务描述、术语、数据标准、安全等级与索引信息
descriptions.en: Retrieves detailed information for each column in a table. This operation returns the metadata (such as type, nullable, and auto-increment), business description, associated terms, data standards, security level, and index information.
